description: For retained ground terms \(s,t\), the specified positive-relation model satisfies \(s=t\) exactly when \((s,t)\) belongs to the computed positive-equation closure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.model_equality_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Problem L)
  (t s : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L)
  (ht : t ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.support Γ)
  (hs : s ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.support Γ) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom.equal t s).Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Carrier Γ) ↔
    (t, s) ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.closure Γ
